source.prompt: Create a text-free premium editorial hero artwork for the standalone Ti-Scale command-intelligence platform. The artwork must be an abstract sculptural titanium scale system, not a device, computer, robot, engine, or interface: five to nine distinct angular plates suspended in a precise exploded formation around an empty central void, with visible clean separation between every layer. Use asymmetric architectural geometry, razor-sharp machined edges, brushed titanium facets, matte graphite seams, sparse warm-metal fasteners, and strong black-and-white Ben-Day halftone or screenprint dither that visibly breaks selected facets into dots. Center the sculpture at 38 percent canvas coverage with generous uninterrupted negative space. Perfectly flat warm off-white #F4F2EE background edge to edge, no floor, horizon, gradient, vignette, reflection, or cast shadow. Calm Swiss modernist editorial art direction, sophisticated corporate technology, print-poster precision, high contrast, no visual clutter. Strictly no green or other colors, no glow, no transparent display, no screen, no circle display, no UI, no HUD, no symbols, text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, circuitry graphics, humans, faces, anatomy, humanoids, armor suits, weapons, vehicles, cyberpunk, hacker imagery, or recognizable intellectual property.

Show the same titanium core in its fully seated, mechanically locked assembled hero state, with every original plate and fastener occupying its source position. Refine only physical realism: premium anisotropic brushed titanium, precise machined edges, believable panel contact, restrained warm-metal perforations, subtle surface variation, and controlled graphite contact shadows. Keep the exact source silhouette, composition, lighting direction and central void. Clean, quiet, monumental, physically buildable 2100-era titanium industrial design.

Single continuous 15-second fixed-camera premium product transformation. The supplied locked assembled hero is the mandatory exact opening state. The supplied engineering exploded-view keyframe is the mandatory exact intermediate state and part map. The supplied architectural-chassis keyframe is the mandatory exact final state. The original Ti-Scale artwork is the immutable identity reference.
Preserve permanent one-to-one tracking of every original titanium component through every frame: exact plate count and order, individual shapes, hard folds, existing seams, perforation fields, fastener locations, brushed-grain direction, graphite undersides, restrained warm-metal accents, central diamond core, proportions, scale, fixed three-quarter perspective, centered 16:9 framing, warm off-white seamless background, graphite shadows, lighting, exposure, and palette. 2.0-6.0 seconds: the exact rigid plates accelerate with convincing inertial mass and move outward and slightly downward along believable existing seam normals and short linear rails, coordinated but subtly staggered, directly matching the engineering exploded-view paths.
6.0-7.2 seconds: arrive exactly at the exploded reference state; firm deceleration, tiny contact rebound, brief micro-vibration settle, readable pause.
7.2-12.8 seconds: without changing identity, those same rigid components rotate on precise articulated joints and extend on restrained telescoping travel into the exact empty architectural-chassis arrangement around the dense central core. Each source part remains continuously traceable.
12.8-15.0 seconds: parts seat mechanically into the destination reference with controlled ease-out, subtle inertial overshoot, tiny contact rebound and short micro-vibration settling; finish motionless on the exact destination state.
Physical choreography only: precise robotic assembly, realistic titanium mass, rigid-body motion, machined tolerances, clean clearances, no collision. One uninterrupted shot. Camera is absolutely locked: no pan, tilt, roll, orbit, dolly, zoom, reframing, lens change, parallax jump, cut, transition, or time discontinuity.
